exceptions.rationale: The remaining vulnerable brace-expansion 1.x and 2.x instances are transitive development-tool dependencies used by linting and SBOM generation only. They are not production dependencies and are not bundled into the browser application.
exceptions.upstreamRemediationCondition: Remove this exception when ESLint, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, CycloneDX, or their transitive dependency ranges resolve GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg without downgrades, global overrides, or forced major/range-breaking changes.
